tools.name: validate_email
tools.description: Validate a single email address in real time using NoBounce API. Checks RFC 5322 syntax, DNS MX records, 5,000+ disposable providers, role accounts, free webmail providers, typo suggestions, and optional SMTP handshake.

tools.name: validate_emails_bulk
tools.description: Validate a batch of up to 1,000 email addresses in a single call using NoBounce API. Returns per-email validation results plus summary counts (valid, invalid, disposable, catch_all, unknown).
